Storybook fix on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`, approved by Marcel: every story rendering an enabled, clickable size-chip group should let a click actually select the chip (both `ZimmSizeChipGroup` and `ZimmProductCardContent` are correctly controlled components — this is a stories-wiring gap, not a component bug).

**File 1 — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.stories.tsx`.** Read the whole file first — it already has the exact pattern to copy twice: a `DefaultExample`/`KeyboardNavigationExample`-style local component using `useState` for `selectedValue` and `onSelect={setSelectedValue}` (the `Default` story was already fixed this way in an earlier round; `KeyboardNavigation` has its own analogous wrapper). Apply the identical pattern to these two stories, which are currently static:
- `WithSelection` (currently `args: { values: SIZES, selectedValue: 'm' }`) — new wrapper seeds `useState` at `'m'` instead of `''`, otherwise identical shape to `Default`'s own wrapper.
- `WithDisabledSize` (currently `args: { values: [...4 entries, one with isDisabled: true], selectedValue: 'm' }`) — new wrapper seeds `useState` at `'m'`, passes the same 4-entry `values` array (including the disabled one) through unchanged, `onSelect={setSelectedValue}`. The disabled chip will correctly remain unselectable via its own native `disabled` attribute — you don't need to do anything special for that, just make the enabled chips genuinely interactive the same way `Default` now is.

Follow this file's own existing naming convention for the new wrapper components (e.g. whatever pattern `Default`'s own wrapper uses — read it to match exactly, don't invent a different shape). Update each story's own doc comment only if it currently implies a static, non-interactive display.

**Do not touch** `OneSize` (a single non-interactive label, not a radiogroup — genuinely nothing to select) or `KeyboardNavigation` (already correct).

**File 2 — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.stories.tsx`.** Only one story renders size chips: `WithSizeChips` (currently `args: { ...Default.args, showSizeChips: true, sizeChipValues: SIZES, selectedSizeChipValue: 'm', onSizeChipSelect: fn() }`). Give it the same treatment — a local stateful wrapper component owning `selectedSizeChipValue` via `useState` (seeded at `'m'`), calling both `setSelectedSizeChipValue` and the original `args.onSizeChipSelect` (the `fn()` spy) so Storybook's Actions panel keeps logging, same pattern as the already-fixed `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx` `Default` story (read that file's `DefaultExample` for the exact narrowing-and-forwarding shape if useful, though `ZimmProductCardContentProps` may not need the same discriminated-union narrowing `ZimmProductCardProps` required — check its actual type first rather than assuming). Every other arg (`name`, `href`, `currentPrice`, `showBag`, `onAddToBag`, etc.) passes through unchanged.

**Do not touch** `Default`, `WithAttributes`, `Unavailable`, `LoadingPrice` in this file — all four inherit `showSizeChips: false` from `Default.args` and render no size-chip picker at all.

When done, report every file touched and the exact diff, confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and run `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx` (22 tests) and `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.test.tsx` (27 tests) to confirm both still pass — stories aren't executed by Vitest, but confirm nothing else broke. Do not stage, do not commit.

62	 * `ZimmProductName`'s own heading-level prop, read off the atom's real signature via a utility
63	 * type rather than a hand-typed duplicate union (typescript.md: "prefer utility types over
